verdicts.reason: A has a strong headline and a large, clear Enter Now CTA. However, the headline's left edge doesn't line up with the copy/CTA column at about x=357, the LIMITED badge sits beside the CTA as a competing pill of similar weight, and the body copy breaks onto a second line holding only 'Thursday.' B keeps the original's column structure but shrinks the Enter Now button until it is smaller and weaker than the LIMITED badge, which buries the CTA. B also wraps the headline awkwardly into 'The Volt / Runner', leaves 'Thursday.' alone on the second line, and floats the CTA off to the right without any alignment.
